selection.why_this_prior: The official ExpeL implementation keeps a global numbered rule list that is injected into evaluation prompts and also retrieves successful trajectory few-shots by similarity. A lesson-only arm is therefore an ExpeL-inspired, not faithful-direct, alternative explanation for a one-task-family outcome-to-behavior effect.
selection.not_selected_as_hswm_mechanism: ExpeL lessons, retrieval state, and prompts are external baseline state. They cannot perform HSWM outcome-to-credit binding, owner assignment, Permit authorization, canonical revision, or HSWM lineage mutation.

paper.title: ExpeL: LLM Agents Are Experiential Learners
paper.venue: Proceedings of the AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence 38(17), 2024

algorithm: A future B2_EXPEL_INSPIRED_TEXT_LESSON arm may collect sealed B2 training trajectories and independently produced outcomes, extract a bounded natural-language lesson artifact, and use it only as explicitly preregistered external baseline state.
This lesson-only arm MUST NOT be described as a faithful ExpeL reproduction because it omits ExpeL's separate successful-trajectory few-shot retrieval channel.

A future B2_EXPEL_DIRECT arm, if used, MUST freeze the resulting global numbered rules before final-holdout inspection, inject those rule bytes into the evaluation prompt through the pinned RULE_TEMPLATE, and separately retrieve successful trajectory few-shots using the pinned retrieval path.
Both B2 variants must score fresh outcomes with the common independent evaluator and cannot authorize HSWM mutation.

faithful_direct_source_observations.global_rule_channel: agent/expel.py creates a numbered global rule string from rule_items; at evaluation insert_before_task_prompt renders it with prompts/templates/human.py RULE_TEMPLATE.
faithful_direct_source_observations.successful_trajectory_fewshot_channel: agent/expel.py builds a FAISS vector store over successful histories and retrieves task-similar few-shots; the effective ALFWorld configuration selects task_similarity and num_fewshots: 2.
faithful_direct_source_observations.rule_cap_ambiguity: The paper's reported cap of 10 rules and this pinned configs/agent/expel.yaml max_num_rules: 20 disagree. No value is selected here; a B2_EXPEL_DIRECT preregistration must resolve and source-justify it before outcome inspection.
faithful_direct_source_observations.retrieval_ambiguity: The pinned configuration says retriever_type: knn, while agent/expel.py also constructs a LangChain FAISS vector store for similarity search. A B2_EXPEL_DIRECT preregistration must specify the exact dependency versions, embeddings, vector-store construction, retriever path, and query/selection semantics; this pin does not infer a single resolved implementation from the source alone.

minimal_reproduction_boundary.executable_closure_status: NOT_PINNED: these files establish algorithm semantics only; a future direct run must separately pin the complete source, configuration, dependency, model, embedding, and environment closure.
excluded: The upstream repository, paper PDF, model weights, environments, datasets, and credentials are not vendored into this repository.
The future B2 arm must not reuse upstream FAISS indexes, logs, caches, API state, or environment state across arms.
No upstream component may directly mutate HSWM canonical state or authorize a HSWM revision.

future_run_contract.b2_only_state: A future run MUST allocate an arm-private, resettable lesson store, trajectory store, retrieval index, cache namespace, and durable-write root. No B2 state may be visible to H0-H3 or another baseline arm.
future_run_contract.resource_parity: The future B2 arm MUST receive the same task information, base model, tools, token, call, retry, time, and human budget as H1 and the named controls; all differences require a receipt and predeclared attribution limitation.
future_run_contract.direct_vs_wrapper_parity: B2_EXPEL_INSPIRED_TEXT_LESSON is lesson-only and must never be called direct ExpeL. Before a B2_EXPEL_DIRECT comparison is credited, a preregistered direct-versus-wrapper parity check MUST show the same global numbered-rule bytes, successful-trajectory few-shot selection and bytes, model-visible prompt bytes, retrieval/vector-store state writes, and resource accounting within declared tolerance.
future_run_contract.network_policy: A future scientific occurrence MUST use a pinned offline or sealed-equivalent source and dependency closure. This source-pin verifier performs no live-network verification.
